content:
Save as otherwise provided in this Act,
(a) a document or proceeding requiring authentication by a company; or
(b) contracts made by or on behalf of a company,
may be signed by any key managerial personnel or 1[an officer or employee of the company] duly authorised by the Board in this behalf.
footnote:
</br><hr style="border-top:1px solid #0778be"/>1. Subs. by Act 1 of 2018, s. 7, for “an officer of the company” (w.e.f. 9-2-2018).
</br><hr class="hr2"/></br><hr style="border-top:1px solid #0778be"/>
